record_scope_reconstruction: Two distinct Bukavu–Rwanda road crossings, Ruzizi I and II; phase applies to the passenger categories admitted in November, not all DRC–Rwanda traffic.

source_checks.finding: Radio Okapi reports South Kivu governor closure of Ruzizi I and II, 22 March; food transport and medical cases excepted.
11 November text names the two posts and permitted passenger categories; Kamanyola announcement is separate.
Appendix A E22/E23 explicitly lists distinct named posts and coordinates.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Two distinct Bukavu–Rwanda road crossings, Ruzizi I and II; phase applies to the passenger categories admitted in November, not all DRC–Rwanda traffic. date_scope_check.qualification_retained: GL17-R1: November 11 is agreement/permission date; effective clock time and first Ruzizi passage unknown. Before-November exceptional passage not exhaustively ruled out; first-easing description supports policy rather than universal physical closure. Kamanyola's later implementation must not be transferred to Ruzizi.
